summary: On February 2, 2026 Progress Foundation, a San Francisco nonprofit, inadvertently disclosed employees' W-2 forms, with names and Social Security numbers, to an unauthorized actor. It found no sign of unauthorized activity on its systems, notified federal law enforcement and the IRS, and offered affected employees credit monitoring.
